Congratulations on your new Gmail account.

Before you reach out to customers, consider upgrading to a customized
business email address, included in the Google Workspace Business Standard
plan.

Google Workspace comes with a lot more than your professional email
address. Change the way you work and:

- Save time drafting documents, summarizing email threads, or building
spreadsheets using AI in Docs, Gmail, and more.

- Stay focused on the conversation while AI captures meeting details in
real time with the “take notes for me” feature in Google Meet.

- Offload the busywork to the Gemini app. Just ask AI to securely tackle
routine tasks with speed and confidence.

- Simplify your scheduling by letting clients book – and pay for –
appointments directly through your Calendar.

- Manage and request eSignatures from vendors, customers, and internal
stakeholders directly in a Doc or PDF.

- Easily create and edit videos for announcements, training, pitches, and
more using Vids, our AI-powered video generator.

- Protect your business from threats, preventing data loss, and meeting
compliance requirements with enterprise-grade security.

When you’re ready for that custom email address, you can effortlessly set
it up and pair it with the premium versions of Google Workspace tools like
Docs, Sheets, Calendar, Gmail, and more. You’ll also get extra storage and
business security to help you run your company more efficiently. Check out
